# claim modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/claimModality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

The modality (unequivocal, probable, conceivable, refuted, bullshit) assigned to a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md). Semantically equivalent to [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) for StandpointClaims, but not declared [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) because [`StandpointModality`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointModality.md) (a [gufo:QualityValue](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue) / abstract individual) is disjoint from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (a [gufo:Endurant](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Endurant)) in the DL profile. When a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) is flattened to an annotated statement, [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) becomes [`standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md).
